Our home inspectors in Seattle/Everett Area are so thorough in their evaluation of the property you’re considering purchasing, You Won’t Get Stuck Buying A “MONEY PIT!” Over the last 10 years our home inspectors at Property Inspector, LLC have protected more than 3500 home buyers just like you and we’ve listened to what they’ve said…“Don’t Let Me Get Stuck With A Bunch Of Unexpected Post Closing Expenses!”

Learn what to look out for when previewing properties you're interested in by watching our videos!
